whatsappMessage:
Hi Team High-Q Food Court,

I noticed your food court has strong 3.7★ ratings with 600+ reviews in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food menu browsing.

Maine aapke food court ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu inquiries, special thali/snacks showcase, aur Google directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://high-q-food-court-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team High-Q Food Court, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital food menu showcase, direct WhatsApp reservations, and Google directions for customers around Bihta main road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
